description: Reviewed exceptions for npm run lint:contracts. Each entry is bound to a SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact declaration or compiler diagnostic it covers; line and subject are for readers. A new or changed finding fails the gate, and so does an entry that no longer matches. These entries describe reviewed existing code. The six source rules for known compiler bugs cannot be allowlisted.

source.subject: records mapping
source.reason: ENSRegistry declares `mapping(bytes32 => Record) records;` without visibility in ensdomains/ens-contracts 3d477d43 (v1.6.2); Hyperion applies the internal default, so no getter exists and the deployed ABI has no records function. The contract is deployed; contract sources stay unchanged in this evidence work.

source.subject: operators mapping
source.reason: ENSRegistry declares `mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) operators;` without visibility in ensdomains/ens-contracts 3d477d43 (v1.6.2); Hyperion applies the internal default and isApprovedForAll is the only reader. The contract is deployed; contract sources stay unchanged in this evidence work.

source.subject: Root.setSubnodeOwner forwards to the registry
source.reason: Root forwards to QNSRegistry.setSubnodeOwner on the root node, and the registry emits NewOwner(0x0, label, owner) in the same transaction. The QNSRootControllable semantic suite pins that event, and the stateful fuzzer checks that every successful state change logs.

source.subject: Root.setResolver forwards to the registry
source.reason: Root forwards to QNSRegistry.setResolver on the root node, and the registry emits NewResolver(0x0, resolver) in the same transaction. The QNSRootControllable semantic suite pins that event, and the stateful fuzzer checks that every successful state change logs.

warnings.subject: pre-release compiler notice
warnings.reason: The pinned compiler is the Hyperion develop build 0.2.0-develop.2026.9.21+commit.302c8805, identified by version and SHA-256 in config/hyperion-toolchain.json. Hyperion has no tagged release yet; moving to a stable release is an open item in docs/FORMAL-SECURITY-VERIFICATION.md. The notice describes the release status of the compiler.

warnings.subject: modifier authorised: local owner
warnings.reason: Modifier authorised declares `address owner`, which shadows the `owner(bytes32)` function (line 126). The modifier reads the raw record owner into the local and never calls the masking getter, which is the intended upstream authorisation check. The declaration is unchanged from ensdomains/ens-contracts 3d477d43 (v1.6.2), and the contract is deployed; contract sources stay unchanged in this evidence work.

The declaration is unchanged from ensdomains/ens-contracts 3d477d43 (v1.6.2), and the contract is deployed; contract sources stay unchanged in this evidence work.
